g.title: note
g.text: First 1,000 outer iterations: supervised only. Completed suite: 10,000 L + 9,000 U + 10,000 EMA updates.
Same optimizers for both student steps: AdamW body LR 3e−5; SGD head LR 3e−3; gradient clip 5.
No LR scheduler. Legacy pseudo_lr does not set the ordinary ema_full pseudo-step learning rate.
A0 has no external-teacher loss or memory; no audit/guard selection; no adaptive/meta-Dice update.
